old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-eebl","title":"Root-seq replay cache is volatile: captured still-unexpired signed DIO replays as Verified after reboot (spec 8.10.1 anti-replay gap)","description":"Found in security review of b7z9.88.3 (receive.rs verify_dio_root_signature). rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs:731: RootSeqCache is in-memory only; cached() returns None after reboot, so a radio adversary can replay a captured still-valid signed DIO (root_seq=N) and it passes the strictly-increasing gate and is accept()ed as Verified — defeating the spec 06 8.10.1 MUST-reject-replay guarantee exactly across the reboot boundary. Persistence infra exists and is already used for DAO replay (MemStorage vs durable storage split) — the DIO root-sig cache was never wired in. Impact bound: window closes at signature expiry (receive.rs:715); Verified and Baseline are treated identically downstream (receive.rs:522-548) today, but anti-replay is the option's stated purpose. Fix shape: persist root-seq high-water marks (keyed dodag_id+instance) through the same storage path used for DAO replay state; consider replay-window/epoch binding if storage is unavailable.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-09-09T16:07:56.850444928Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-09-09T16:07:56.850444928Z","labels":["networking","rust","security"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-eebl","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.88.3","type":"discovered-from","created_at":"2026-09-09T16:07:56.96302292Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
